title: Kholmsk municipal bus-service workers’ stoppage over wage arrears
reason: Not a public gathering; the retrospective report says 45 employees stopped work, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: VKPB’s Feb. 27 retrospective says the municipal-enterprise workers sought payment of wage arrears. The reported labor dispute is recorded as an excluded lead rather than a street assembly; no independent corroboration was found.
